documents.note: Scan, 6 pp: PURE cover letter 8/28/24 + Texas Realtors TXR-2216 itemization (damages 2,720; deposit tendered 0.00; excess demanded) + USPS certified mail label. Sole PM move-out accounting doc.
PM Rockets turn invoice: Tenant Expenses 2,720 (itemized sub-amounts) + Owner Expenses 2,850 (full interior paint, owner). Used only to split the itemization lump into categories.
Original TXR lease 11/18/2022-11/16/2023, rent 2,070, deposit 2,320 (waived via addendum). Auto-renews MTM; holdover = 3x rent.
TXR-2005 extension effective 11/17/2023, expires 11/14/2024, rent 2,200; 45-day move-out notice.
GDAA/PURE Security Deposit Waiver addendum: YES, $69/month, waives $2,320 deposit; signed 11/16/2022.
Rent Manager ledger (oldest-first). Paid through July 2024; 8/1/24 charges zeroed 'Tenant moved out 7/31/2024'; 8/28/24 'Security Deposit Forfeit - Move Out Charges' 2,720 is the only open item.

lease.lease_break_terms: Para 28 early termination only by agreement/law (no tenant right for job transfer etc.); Para 27 default allows lost rent + reletting costs; holdover 3x rent. No lease-break fee amount stated; PM billed none.

line_items.description: Repair dog scratches on back exterior door frame (wood putty + paint)

Remove gate at top/bottom of stairs, repair drywall, paint to match
Remove hardware from walls and patch

Paint over pink splatter with white straight line
Paint all sides of interior garage doors with white gloss
Handyman: replace door stoppers in bedroom 3
Handyman: labor to replace 2-3 damaged fence pickets (pickets owner-provided)
Professional carpet cleaning, all carpeted areas
Move-out cleaning (walls, appliances, shelves, cabinets, grout stain, tile steam, garage sweep)
Pressure wash front and back porch
OWNER EXPENSE (not billed to tenant): full interior wall/trim painting of 2-story house

credits.description: Invoice sub-items for Tenant Expenses sum to 2,810 but invoice line, TXR-2216 itemization and ledger all bill 2,720; 90 difference treated as implicit discount so lines reconcile to PM-billed amount

reconciliation: Sum tenant lines 2,810.00 - credit 90.00 (invoice sub-items over-sum vs billed total) = 2,720.00 = PM stated 2,720.00 (TXR-2216, ledger 8/28/24 charge, invoice Tenant Expenses subtotal); owner painting 2,850 excluded (amount_open 0).
notes: Early termination: tenant vacated 7/31/2024 vs renewal term end 11/14/2024; PM zeroed 8/1/24 rent and billed no future rent, lease-break or reletting fee. Rent paid through July 2024 (ledger). Deposit tendered 0.00 (waived 2,320, 69/mo premium on ledger as 'Renters Choice Program'). Dog scratch repair is the only pet-related line (monthly pet fee on lease shows pet was approved). Invoice is dated 9/6/24, after the 8/28/24 itemization, yet totals match. PURE cover letter threatens 35% collection charge if unpaid in 30 days (hypothetical, not a charge). Original lease in file is the 2022-23 term; current term facts come from the renewal extension.
